analysis_walkthrough.business_objective_summary: The objective is to verify the raw artifacts produced in the stage1 output of a software pipeline.
requirements_understanding: The verification process needs to ensure that artifacts meet predefined quality and completeness criteria.
Verification should be automated to ensure consistency and efficiency.
Error handling and observability are critical to identify and resolve issues quickly.
conversion_to_technical_requirements: Implement automated verification scripts or tools to check artifacts against quality criteria.
Integrate logging and monitoring to track verification process and outcomes.
Define error handling procedures for failed verifications.
clarifications_requested: What specific quality criteria should the artifacts meet?
Are there any existing tools or scripts for verification that need to be integrated?

output.executive_summary: This project aims to automate the verification of raw artifacts in the stage1 output to ensure they meet quality and completeness criteria.

functional_requirements.title: Automated Artifact Verification
functional_requirements.description: Develop a system to automatically verify raw artifacts in stage1 output against predefined criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Artifacts are verified automatically upon generation.
Verification results are logged with timestamps and artifact identifiers.
Verification process completes within 5 minutes of artifact generation.

functional_requirements.title: Quality Criteria Definition
functional_requirements.description: Define the quality criteria that artifacts must meet for successful verification.
acceptance_criteria: Quality criteria are documented and accessible to all stakeholders.
Criteria include checks for completeness, format, and integrity.
Criteria are reviewed and updated quarterly.

functional_requirements.title: Error Handling for Verification Failures
functional_requirements.description: Implement error handling procedures for cases where artifacts fail verification.
acceptance_criteria: Failed verifications trigger an alert to the responsible team.
Error logs include detailed information about the failure.
A retry mechanism is available for failed verifications.

functional_requirements.title: Verification Logging and Monitoring
functional_requirements.description: Integrate logging and monitoring for the verification process to ensure transparency and traceability.
acceptance_criteria: All verification activities are logged with relevant metadata.
Monitoring dashboards display real-time verification status.
Logs are retained for a minimum of 90 days.

functional_requirements.title: Artifact Metadata Capture
functional_requirements.description: Capture and store metadata for each artifact to support verification and traceability.
acceptance_criteria: Metadata includes artifact ID, creation timestamp, and creator.
Metadata is stored in a centralized repository.
Metadata is accessible for audit purposes.

functional_requirements.title: Integration with Existing Tools
functional_requirements.description: Integrate the verification system with existing tools used in the pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Verification system interfaces with existing CI/CD tools.
Integration does not degrade the performance of existing tools.
Integration is documented and tested.

functional_requirements.title: User Notification System
functional_requirements.description: Develop a notification system to inform users of verification results.
acceptance_criteria: Users receive notifications for both successful and failed verifications.
Notifications include a summary of the verification results.
Users can configure notification preferences.

functional_requirements.title: Verification Process Documentation
functional_requirements.description: Document the verification process and make it available to all stakeholders.
acceptance_criteria: Documentation includes process flow, criteria, and error handling.
Documentation is reviewed and updated annually.
Stakeholders have access to the latest version of the documentation.

non_functional_requirements.title: Performance of Verification Process
non_functional_requirements.description: The verification process should be efficient and not introduce significant delays.
acceptance_criteria: Average verification time is under 5 minutes.
Verification process does not exceed 10% of total pipeline time.
Performance metrics are logged and reviewed monthly.

non_functional_requirements.title: System Reliability
non_functional_requirements.description: The verification system should be reliable and available during pipeline operations.
acceptance_criteria: System uptime is maintained at 99.9% or higher.
Downtime incidents are logged and analyzed.
A backup system is available in case of primary system failure.

non_functional_requirements.title: Security of Verification Data
non_functional_requirements.description: Ensure that verification data is secure and protected from unauthorized access.
non_functional_requirements.metric: Data access is logged and restricted to authorized users.
acceptance_criteria: Access to verification data is controlled via role-based access.
All access attempts are logged and reviewed monthly.
Data encryption is applied to stored verification data.

non_functional_requirements.title: Usability of Verification System
non_functional_requirements.description: The verification system should be user-friendly and easy to navigate.
non_functional_requirements.metric: User satisfaction score of 80% or higher.
acceptance_criteria: User feedback is collected and analyzed quarterly.
System interface is intuitive and requires minimal training.
Documentation is available to assist users in navigating the system.

non_functional_requirements.title: Scalability of Verification System
non_functional_requirements.description: The system should be able to handle increased load as the number of artifacts grows.
non_functional_requirements.metric: System can handle a 50% increase in artifacts without performance degradation.
acceptance_criteria: System performance is maintained with a 50% increase in artifacts.
Scalability tests are conducted bi-annually.
System architecture supports horizontal scaling.

recommended_strategy.name: Phased modernization
recommended_strategy.rationale: Preserve behavior first, then modernize in controlled phases.

phases.title: Baseline and equivalence harness
phases.outcome: Capture golden flows and baseline outputs.

phases.title: Incremental migration and dependency replacement
phases.outcome: Migrate forms/modules with dependency risk controls.

phases.title: Hardening and release evidence
phases.outcome: Finalize quality gates and publish evidence pack.

blocking.question: Target UI framework selection for migrated forms
blocking.default_recommendation: WinForms for lowest event-model delta from VB6 unless UX redesign is in scope.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: High rework risk in form/event parity and control migration.

blocking.question: ActiveX/OCX replacement strategy by dependency
blocking.default_recommendation: Replace common controls and isolate only high-risk dependencies behind adapters.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Runtime regressions and release delays from unresolved control behavior.

blocking.question: Database contract strategy during migration
blocking.default_recommendation: Preserve contracts initially and modernize behind a compatibility layer.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Business rule drift and data-side regressions.

blocking.question: What are target latency, throughput, and availability SLOs?
blocking.default_recommendation: Resolve with product/business owner before implementation commitment.

non_blocking.question: Logging and observability stack for migrated runtime
non_blocking.default_recommendation: OpenTelemetry + structured logs for parity troubleshooting.

team.name: Synthetix Balanced Team
team.description: General-purpose delivery team for most product tasks.

1.persona: Translate business ambiguity into structured, testable requirements with explicit acceptance criteria.

2.persona: Design low-latency, secure, scalable architectures with concrete trade-offs and deployment pragmatism.

3.persona: Generate minimal, buildable code quickly with clear boundaries, robust health endpoints, and reliable packaging.

4.persona: Design low-risk schema/data migration scripts with rollback plans and validation checkpoints.

5.persona: Produce threat models, prioritized security controls, and release-gating recommendations.

6.persona: Run actionable checks, separate environment issues from code defects, and produce clear remediation guidance.

7.persona: Validate requirement coverage clearly for business stakeholders with traceable evidence.

8.persona: Prefer local Docker deployability, deterministic health checks, and clear run instructions.

blocking.question: Target UI framework selection for migrated forms
blocking.default_recommendation: WinForms for lowest event-model delta from VB6 unless UX redesign is in scope.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: High rework risk in form/event parity and control migration.

blocking.question: ActiveX/OCX replacement strategy by dependency
blocking.default_recommendation: Replace common controls and isolate only high-risk dependencies behind adapters.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Runtime regressions and release delays from unresolved control behavior.

blocking.question: Database contract strategy during migration
blocking.default_recommendation: Preserve contracts initially and modernize behind a compatibility layer.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Business rule drift and data-side regressions.

blocking.question: What are target latency, throughput, and availability SLOs?
blocking.default_recommendation: Resolve with product/business owner before implementation commitment.

non_blocking.question: Logging and observability stack for migrated runtime
non_blocking.default_recommendation: OpenTelemetry + structured logs for parity troubleshooting.
